Targeting a Multi-Billion-Dollar AI Leader: Fake Bittensor Packages to Steal Wallet Assets and Hijack GPU Compute Power

HelixGuard discovered a supply-chain attack targeting ​Bittensor (TAO)​, a leading decentralized AI network. The attacker published fake Python packages such as ​gztensor-cli​, which when installed by users, steals wallet private-key passwords and hijacks GPU compute power.

ComfyUI-Manager Remote Code Execution Analysis and Proof of Concept

ComfyUI-Manager is a companion extension manager for ComfyUI, a node-based Stable Diffusion inference framework. A remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2025-67303) was discovered in ComfyUI-Manager that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the host system.

2025-12-10HelixGuard Team5 min read

How widespread is the impact of Critical Security Vulnerability in React Server Components(CVE-2025-55182)

React Server Components (RSC) are a new feature in React that allows developers to render React components on the server. However, a critical security vulnerability in RSC could allow an attacker to inject arbitrary commands into the server's command execution environment. This could lead to unauthorized access, data exposure, or even complete system compromise.
